source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Wave-1 row 68 (Character Shaun, Quaternius Animated models misc) is only on poly.pizza / quaternius.com (Cloudflare challenge / off limits). Substituted with Casual3_Male from the Quaternius Ultimate Animated Character Pack (Nov 2019) on OpenGameArt, the same CC0 pack, rig and 11 clips as man-casual (no run, jump or death clip). Of the pack's two other everyday men it differs most from man-casual (Casual_Male: T-shirt, shorts, mop of hair): a sleeveless tank top, full-length trousers and thick swept-back hair; Casual2_Male is another T-shirt with trousers and a quiff. Like all the pack's casual men the feet are bare skin (no shoes). Height 1.75 m: the chibi big head is the artist's, the overall size a grown man's.
